chapter: Band personalities, Duke's last years and the office
title: Did Duke carry money?
summary: Rose says he carried little; Juan says he kept big bills, like Freddie Guy and Mark Niel.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: He never carried money, I know that.
He never carried but a little money in his pocket.
Oh, don't believe that. He used to put it right in his pocket here and he used to have two or three $100 bills in there all the time.
That's when Mark Niel used to tell him ...
Oh, just like Freddie Guy, all the time, Freddie had at last a one hundred dollar bill in his pocket all the time.

And Niel used to carry it in that little pocket right there, and he had his suits made, and he had a button made so he could push that down and -- well, not a button, but a snap, you know? That you push down and then snap it.
And he carried it like a little watch pocket almost?
What's that little pocket in mens' pockets right here?
I don't know; I just have one here.
That little tiny one; you know what I mean, in the top of the pants pocket.
He used to keep it in there all the time.
